about.title: Đinh Thị Thu Chang
about.p1: Through years of close collaboration with Korean partners — from brand launch ceremonies and distribution agreement signings to working visits across Korea — Chang has built her reputation on genuine, hands-on partnership in every project.
about.p2: Beyond a single field, Chang aims to be a comprehensive bridge: legal support that gives Vietnamese travelers confidence abroad and foreign residents confidence in Vietnam, authentic Korean products, and career opportunities for the next generation.

items.q: Does Chang handle the entire visa process, or just consulting?
items.a: Full service: choosing the right visa type, preparing documents, and continuous progress tracking until completion.

items.q: Are the Korean products clearly sourced and authentic?
items.a: Yes. Red ginseng, cosmetics and food products are all authentically imported with clear partners and documentation — including Hwang Pung Jung Since 1908.

items.q: Who is the vocational training program for?
items.a: For young people looking to build practical vocational skills and connect to job opportunities, domestically or abroad.

items.q: What's the fastest way to reach you?
items.a: Call or message on Zalo at 0988 818 936 for the quickest response. You can also reach out via KakaoTalk, ID Changkum.
